Only in Etherlords II

It comes into play as enchantment. Whenever a hero casts a sorcery spell it becomes X/X pale aspect Pale creature possessing Dissipation, Cryptic Manifestation and Final Courtesy abilities, where X is the casting cost of the sorcery that has triggered this ability
